purpose: Fleet-independent administration of scheduled database backups, returned backup-run history, integrity checks and restore previews, plus portable settings JSON export/import.
primaryGoal: Configure and inspect data protection, download or verify completed snapshots, and transfer supported settings safely without confusing a preview with a database restore.

dataSources.name: configsQuery
dataSources.behavior: Independent snapshot; missing payload defaults to [] for iteration, while summary raw values use hasData. Local DataState preserves retained rows on refresh failure.
dataSources.knownLimits: Reads do not forward TanStack Query's AbortSignal. No vehicle/date scope is requested.

dataSources.name: runsQuery
dataSources.behavior: Polls every 5 seconds if a returned row is queued/running; otherwise every 30 seconds. All summary/reliability calculations use only this returned array.
dataSources.knownLimits: Backend defaults to limit=50, offset=0 and permits limit up to 200 (restore_handler.go:148-171). Page sends neither bound; DataTable pagination only paginates loaded rows. Summary explicitly discloses returned-list coverage, but older history is not fetched.

dataSources.name: Backup operations
dataSources.behavior: Config changes and triggers invalidate both existing query keys. Verify reports a toast; download uses apiUrl and window.open; preview fetches tables and checksum flag into a modal. Delete route uses RequireSudo. No database-restore mutation exists in this inspected router group or page.
dataSources.knownLimits: No operations were executed. Preview endpoint says it parses without importing, but processor internals were not inspected. checksum_verified is derived from run.Checksum != nil, not the result of VerifyBackup.

dataSources.name: Portable settings bundle
dataSources.sourceOwner: Settings export/import handlers registered in internal\api\router.go:3680-3681
dataSources.behavior: Export caches bundle and downloads JSON. Import parses a <=1 MiB file, validates schema, previews dry_run=true section counts, then explicitly applies dry_run=false through requiresLiveMode=true and shared sudo handling. Cancelled sudo keeps preview. Supported sections: settings, alert_rules, geofences, quiet_hours.
dataSources.knownLimits: Schema helper implementation and backend settings handlers were not inspected; component/hook contracts are source evidence, not proof of backend secrecy or merge guarantees.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.usage: Page title/subtitle, responsive full-width content, secondary actions, aggregated freshness and independent dataSources.

components.name: AdminSummary / OperationalBrief
components.usage: Six source-backed metrics adapted by useOperationalMetrics, with source scope and trust status; do not replace with another KPI implementation.

components.name: LayoutCard / SourceContent / QueryError / EmptyState / Skeleton
components.usage: Persistent configuration/history/reliability shells; independent fatal recovery, custom empty CTAs, retained notices and contextual loading.

components.name: DataTable
components.usage: Three stable tableIds, canonical raw value filters, loaded-row pagination and sortable run fields. Current mobileColumns hide non-allowlisted cells below md; mobilePresentation is the existing opt-in full-detail alternative.

components.name: MetricBar
components.usage: Completion ratio and provider byte footprint. Existing size='slim' and fill='solid' support less decorative tracks; unknown numeric values remain representable.

components.name: Modal / ConfirmDialog / Input / Select / Textarea / Toggle / FormSection
components.usage: Create/edit provider-aware configuration form, destructive confirmation and read-only restore-preview dialog. ConfirmDialog already exposes loading and confirmDisabled.

components.name: SettingsExportImport
components.usage: Canonical portable settings transfer surface mounted here, distinct from database snapshots. Internal SectionDiffList preserves per-section counters.

components.name: DataSourceNotice / deriveDataState
components.usage: Existing source-scoped retry/paused/refresh-failed notices and retained payload contract. Page must not introduce another trust vocabulary.

components.name: Typography / Badge / Button / TimeStamp / FadeIn
components.usage: Localized labels, semantic status, accessible named row actions, shared time display and motion. No new font, palette, overlay or icon registry is required.

duplicatedPatterns.rule: MDC-002 / mission 33: keep pages as orchestrators
duplicatedPatterns.detail: Configuration and history panels repeat source-state branching, specialized empty bodies and DataTable composition; source fetching and domain column definitions also occupy the 1,153-line page. Reliability has a third bespoke state branch.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Extract page-owned config table, history table, reliability and config-form components; retain existing SourceContent rather than creating another generic async panel. Move only this page's typed backup queries/mutations behind a domain hook after explicit ownership is assigned.

responsive.rule: MDC-023 / MDC-043: preserve mobile data and actions
responsive.detail: Configs allow only name/provider/schedule on mobile; frequency, type/options and action cells are hidden. Runs at line 950 allow only file_name/status/created_at, hiding size, records, duration, provider, run type and download/verify/preview actions. DataTable.tsx:724-725 applies hidden md:table-cell; neither caller supplies mobilePresentation or expandable details.
responsive.fix: Adopt DataTable's existing mobilePresentation adapter with stable row keys, all displayed fields in details and reachable row actions. Preserve desktop pipeline, filters, ordering, pagination, tableIds and loaded-result export semantics. Do not add a second mobile table controller.

responsive.detail: Export explanation/button is an unwrapped horizontal flex row; preview filename and Change file share another row at line 348. Long translated text and filenames have no explicit filename wrapping or small-container stacking policy.
responsive.fix: Use the existing density/spacing tokens with container-aware wrapping/stacking and break-word treatment, retaining every explanation, count and action. Exercise 320px, long translations and 200% text before declaring overflow.

accessibility.rule: MDC-021 / MDC-040: programmatic requirements and field feedback
accessibility.detail: Required provider fields only append ' *' to translated labels; Input/Textarea at lines 1017-1033 receive no required or aria-required. Save at line 1062 is disabled only for blank name, so required provider values are not checked here. The container is not a form; native submit validation would not run merely by adding required.
accessibility.fix: Use explicit stable field IDs, required semantics and page-owned validated submit behavior with localized per-field feedback before issuing the same mutation. Preserve technical keys, defaults, secret/password types and backend authentication.

accessibility.rule: MDC-040: contextual action names and target reachability
accessibility.detail: Icon-only actions have localized names, but repeated Edit/Delete/Trigger/Download labels omit row identity. Small compact buttons need real target/focus review; no measured 44px or keyboard result is claimed. Mobile hidden actions are a separate confirmed source issue.
accessibility.fix: Include configuration/run identity in localized accessible action names without exposing credentials, retain visible focus and use current Button sizing/mobile adapter policies. Validate table navigation and all open dialog states.

states.rule: MDC-026: initial paused/unknown is not empty
states.detail: Panel state maps isLoading -> loading, stale -> retained, otherwise [] -> empty. A first-load paused query can have no data, isLoading=false, fatalError=null and status='initial'; configurations/history then announce no data and offer mutation CTAs even though nothing was observed. Reliability at line 835 has the same no-data branch. The page-level DataSourceNotice reports paused, but does not repair contradictory empty panel content.
states.fix: Gate authoritative empty state on successful source availability; represent initial paused/unknown separately while preserving independently available neighbors. Reuse current DataState/DataSourceNotice and avoid guessed counts.

states.rule: MDC-020 / MDC-024: pending destructive operation feedback
states.detail: Delete confirmation never receives loading={deleteMutation.isPending}. The shared dialog supports loading, disables both buttons and prevents Escape/backdrop cancellation when busy; this call leaves repeated confirms and cancellation possible during the request.
states.fix: Pass existing loading contract and keep dialog mounted until the existing success/error callbacks resolve. Do not weaken danger confirmation or RequireSudo.

states.rule: MDC-026: asynchronous preview recovery and race safety
states.detail: Preview requests have no in-flight row state, AbortSignal or obsolete-request guard. The modal opens only after success; repeated clicks on different completed rows can let the last-resolving request replace the intended selection. The TableSkeleton inside an open preview modal is not the normal initial request state.
states.fix: Use a selected-run keyed read hook with signal forwarding and independent loading/error/retry; preserve table/checksum fields and ensure switching/closing cannot commit an obsolete preview.

visualIssues.detail: Active dropzone uses border-neon-cyan and bg-neon-cyan/5. The dedicated backup page itself has zero neon class matches; its imported transfer surface still escalates decoration for drag state.
visualIssues.fix: Use restrained existing accent/border/surface tokens for active drop feedback, retaining visible state and focus distinction. Do not change saved theme IDs or force-reset explicit user palettes.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-012 / MDC-025: meaning-driven theme-aware status
visualIssues.detail: Completed/failed/running icon colors are fixed emerald/rose/cyan-300; preview checksum text repeats fixed colors at line 1103. Provider identities also use warning/info/success badge tones despite not being severity states (lines 117-122). Shared labels keep these color-independent, but light-theme contrast and unnecessary semantic hue are unmeasured.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse subdued semantic foreground tokens for actual success/error/progress; use neutral provider badges with existing labels/icons. Measure effective contrast in themes rather than assuming 300-level colors pass.

visualIssues.detail: Completion/provider bars omit fill and size, so existing MetricBar defaults to animated gradient and 2.5-height track. Provider chart-series colors are legitimate identity encodings, not a new neon palette, but a whole side panel of gradients increases emphasis.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse MetricBar fill='solid', size='slim' with source-backed labels/counts/bytes and current chosen palette. Keep reduced-motion behavior and all measurements; no shared rewrite is needed.

architectureIssues.detail: Both list queryFns ignore the supplied query context and do not pass signal into request().
architectureIssues.fix: Use queryFn: ({ signal }) => request(path, { signal }) inside a typed backup domain hook, preserving query keys, intervals and inherited policy.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-026 / preservation: distinguish loaded history from complete history
architectureIssues.detail: Only backend's default first 50 runs are fetched. DataTable pagination at line 958 cannot reach additional server rows. Summary correctly says returned-list measurements, but Backup history offers no server paging or coverage bound.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain current snapshot metric semantics and explicitly surface coverage. If complete-history navigation is assigned, use existing limit/offset server parameters and preserve loaded versus full-result export distinction; a total is unknown until supplied by backend.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-026 / MDC-045: do not overstate integrity evidence
architectureIssues.detail: Preview says 'Checksum verified' when checksum_verified=true; inspected backend sets that flag solely from run.Checksum != nil (restore_handler.go:358). Separate VerifyBackup actually invokes processor.VerifyBackup (line 301). Stored checksum presence is not proof that preview verified it.
architectureIssues.fix: Coordinate API evidence semantics with the backend owner; until established, show checksum presence rather than success verification in preview. Preserve standalone Verify action and never invent an integrity result.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-046: preserve configuration values through edit
architectureIssues.detail: BackupConfig includes optional include_tables at line 60 and ConfigFormData includes it via Omit, but openEdit reconstructs form without it. Updating an existing selective config may omit its table selection. Backend omission/preservation behavior was not traced.
architectureIssues.fix: Confirm update contract with the domain owner and retain include_tables on edit/save without inventing a new selector or changing full/incremental behavior. Treat omission as a preservation risk, not permission to remove it.

Correct initial-paused versus empty mapping and destructive pending state.
Resolve checksum evidence wording with backend contract owner.
Add cancellation/race-safe preview using existing query infrastructure.
Preserve edit payload, clarify loaded history coverage, then decompose and reduce decorative emphasis.

competingImplementations.name: Operational snapshot versus portable settings transfer
competingImplementations.assessment: Distinct preserved capabilities, not duplicate backups. Do not merge away either flow or add a competing export/import renderer.

competingImplementations.name: Source-content wrappers
competingImplementations.assessment: Existing SourceContent already fits configs/history; reliability duplicates branch logic. Reuse shared state owner, not another universal panel.

competingImplementations.name: Backup domain query ownership
competingImplementations.assessment: Page owns inline types and operations, whereas settings transfer already owns typed hooks. No second backup-hook implementation was verified; extraction must preserve exact cache and mutation behavior.

sections.name: Backup overview
sections.details: Six metrics: configs, backups, success rate, failed runs, last backup, total size; description/scope/status retained.

sections.name: Reliability & storage
sections.details: Three subsections: success ratio, storage by provider, five recent failed-run error messages.

sections.name: Backup history
sections.details: Nine columns: time/run type/status/provider/file/size/records/duration/actions; refresh, filters, loaded pagination.

sections.name: Portable settings JSON bundle
sections.details: Export and import; file picker/dropzone, preview/apply section counters, recovery and done flow.

sections.name: Delete confirmation
sections.details: Named destructive confirmation with cancel and backend sudo.

sections.name: Restore preview modal
sections.details: Checksum message, table names/row counts, empty table state and close; no database restore Apply action.

actions: New configuration from header and config-empty CTA
Edit configuration, cancel, create or save changes
Change provider and its technical credential fields
Change full/incremental, schedule frequency and retention
Quick backup from header and run-empty CTA
Filter and paginate loaded configuration/history/preview rows
Download completed snapshot through canonical apiUrl
Verify completed snapshot and display success/warning/error toast
Preview completed snapshot and close preview
Choose or drop JSON bundle; validate size/schema and preview section changes
Change file/cancel dry-run, apply changes through live-mode/sudo gate
Retain preview when sudo cancelled; retry apply after error; reset after completion
data: Keep raw wire/cache values, existing backup query keys, inherited policies and 5s/30s polling.

Keep file_size as backend bytes and duration_ms as current API milliseconds; use existing formatting only at display boundary. This audit does not relabel backend duration_ms as SI seconds or change wire units.
Keep unknown summary rawValue undefined; an empty loaded run list has unknown success percentage, not a fabricated success rate.
Keep summary explicitly bounded to returned list, first returned completed row for last backup and all-run denominator including queued/running.
Keep provider grouping, missing provider fallback to local, sum behavior, current ordering and recent-error slice semantics unless separately authorized.
Keep independent configs/runs fatal errors and retained data, page-level source notices and neighbor visibility.
Keep full/incremental and local/S3/Azure/GCS options, defaults, provider_config keys, password fields and provider-switch reset.
Preserve optional include_tables through edit after confirming backend semantics; current omission is an unresolved preservation risk.
Keep backup metadata/checksum fields in typed payloads; metadata currently is not rendered, so no invented metadata section is counted as existing.
Keep previewTables null fallback and distinguish no tables from absent/failed preview.
Keep stable table IDs, raw filter values, loaded rows and existing user table persistence; no fake full-result export or fabricated total.
Keep canonical settings bundle ownership, 1 MiB intake limit, four section count displays, apply live-mode requirement and authentication cancellation behavior.
Keep /backup fleet-wide with no workspace range or vehicle selectors: workspaceScope.ts:22-76 does not enable range, and :114 explicitly disables vehicle.
Keep localized labels/technical source values, shared formatting, typography, motion and user theme/format preferences.
